plugins.description: Proposed / unreleased catalog of 37 reusable GBB skills, including the unpublished AgentOps addition: Azure infra (azd, Bicep, ACA, ACA Jobs), Foundry agents (prompt agents, hosted agents, routines, RAG, MCP, evals, observability, AgentOps adoption and release evidence, network runbook), governance (Citadel, AGT), cost analysis, tenant isolation, and enterprise automation.
